Lesson 1: Letter Mm

LESSON 1 OF 26
Mm
🥭
Mango

Meet the letter M

Look at the big M and small m. Listen to the sound, then say it aloud.

Audio uses your device's built-in speech voice when available. Some voices may need to be installed first.

1. Letter recognition

Choose the letter that matches the sound and picture.

2. Letter tracing

Trace the uppercase and lowercase letters. Watch the animated hand demonstrate each stroke, then follow the guide. Complete the guided strokes to finish practice.

START LESSON 1☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆
Start lesson 1 at the green dot and follow the arrow.

This is practice, not a formal handwriting assessment. Guided stroke checking is available for selected letters; other letters are free-tracing practice and are not automatically scored.

3. Fill in the missing letter

Look at the word and choose the missing first letter.

_ANGO

4. Picture matching

Listen to the word, then choose the picture that matches that exact word.

5. Syllable blending

Read the parts, then say the whole word.

6. Word reading

Choose a word and listen to the model. Online: use the microphone for an approximate automatic speech check when your browser supports it. Offline: say the word aloud and ask your teacher to assess it.

Select a word to begin.

Teacher-verified pronunciation

The learner says the selected word aloud. Listen and record your observation. This works without internet.

Automatic speech checking is an approximate speech-to-text match and usually needs internet. Offline, teachers can listen and record an observation. Text-to-speech works offline only when a suitable voice is available on the device.

7. Sentence reading

Read each sentence. Press the speaker button to hear a model.

Teacher note: Lesson content is based on the supplied learning materials. Please review word choices and pronunciation models before classroom use.
